query_hash_rule: At execution, record SHA-256 of the reviewed canonical query manifest; no unevidenced hash is committed by this specification.

evidence_manifest.execution_status: Classic aggregate bundle executed read-only and rolled back; normalized minimum query set is rerunnable; future execution must regenerate result and bundle hashes
evidence_manifest.transaction: REPEATABLE READ; TRANSACTION READ ONLY; ROLLBACK
evidence_manifest.bundle_identity_canonicalization: UTF-8 text joined with literal | in this order: manifest_version, database, schema_fingerprint, executed_at_utc_date, evaluation_timezone, aggregate_result_hash_sha256
evidence_manifest.snapshot_limitation: This is an aggregate evidence bundle identity, not a reusable row-level database snapshot. Row selection requires a newly coordinated protected snapshot.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT INS_ID, PAT_ID, InsType, Scheme, MemberNo, Company, IssueDate, ExpiryDate, Plan FROM uuhms.insurance ORDER BY INS_ID ASC
SELECT PAT_ID, Company, BillStatus FROM uuhms.patients ORDER BY PAT_ID ASC
queries.output: protected runtime only; same PATIENT-EXT-001 snapshot

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_total, SUM(INS_ID IS NULL) AS key_null, SUM(INS_ID <= 0) AS key_nonpositive, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT INS_ID) AS key_duplicate FROM uuhms.insurance

SELECT SUM(i.PAT_ID IS NULL) AS null_ref, SUM(i.PAT_ID = 0) AS zero_ref, SUM(i.PAT_ID <> 0 AND p.PAT_ID IS NOT NULL) AS matched_ref, SUM(i.PAT_ID <> 0 AND p.PAT_ID IS NULL) AS orphan_ref FROM uuhms.insurance i LEFT JOIN uuhms.patients p ON p.PAT_ID = i.PAT_ID
SELECT InsType, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM uuhms.insurance GROUP BY InsType ORDER BY InsType
queries.output: allow-listed categories or collapse to unknown

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT SUM(TRIM(Company) = '') AS blank_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(Company), '')) AS distinct_nonblank FROM uuhms.insurance
SELECT SUM(TRIM(MemberNo) = '') AS blank_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(MemberNo), '')) AS distinct_nonblank FROM uuhms.insurance

SELECT SUM(IssueDate = '0000-00-00') AS issue_zero, SUM(ExpiryDate = '0000-00-00') AS expiry_zero, SUM(IssueDate <> '0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate <> '0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate < IssueDate) AS reversed FROM uuhms.insurance
SELECT BillStatus, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM uuhms.patients GROUP BY BillStatus ORDER BY BillStatus
queries.output: allow-listed categories or collapse to unknown

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT SUM(TRIM(Scheme) = '') AS scheme_blank, SUM(TRIM(Scheme) = '-') AS scheme_hyphen, SUM(TRIM(Plan) = '') AS plan_blank FROM uuhms.insurance

SELECT match_count, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM (SELECT i.INS_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT p.PINS_ID) AS match_count FROM uuhms.insurance i LEFT JOIN uuhms.sett_private p ON UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(i.Company), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) IN (UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(p.PrivateName), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')), UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(p.PrivateShort), '[[:space:]]+', ' '))) WHERE TRIM(i.Company) <> '' GROUP BY i.INS_ID) candidates GROUP BY match_count ORDER BY match_count
queries.output: aggregate diagnostic only; never a target provider map

records.mode: full ordered snapshot + protected content hash
records.resume: last fully emitted protected INS_ID plus unchanged bundle/snapshot/query/key versions

records.mode: projection of identical Phase 2C patient snapshot
records.resume: same PATIENT-EXT-001 checkpoint and unchanged patient snapshot only
records.stop: separately timed patient snapshot or upstream drift
